Method of Attack: Ransomware targeting Windows and VMware ESXi systems
Rust-based locker with real-time negotiation chat portal
Excludes certain system locales from encryption
Encrypts files using Salsa20 algorithm with intermittent encryption
Installs encryptor as a service and reboots system into safe mode with network
Encrypts selected files, directories, network shares, and hidden drives
Deletes shadow copies and supports self-deletion
Linux version disables all virtual machines on ESXi
Uses a constant variable in encryption similar to Petya ransomware
Potential encryption implementation bugs allowing private key recovery
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note demanding payment within five days
Separate domains in the Tor network for affiliates and victims
Use of MPR.dll to collect network resource information
Public key stored at end of encrypted file on Linux
